sector_model: nonfinancial software: no debt line seen, large cash and securities plus a private strategic stake (Anthropic) whose unrealized gains distort GAAP earnings; judged on operating income, FCF, SBC and net cash, not headline net income
thesis: Zoom (fiscal year ends Jan 31) is a mature collaboration and contact-center software company. Q2 FY27 (quarter to 2026-07-31) revenue 1,277.2M (+4.9%), Enterprise +7.8% (787.5M), Online +0.6%; GAAP operating margin 24.6%, non-GAAP 40.0%; Enterprise net dollar expansion 99%. TTM to 2026-07-31 (FY26 10-K minus 6M FY26 plus 6M FY27, XBRL and 10-Q): revenue 4,993.1M, operating income 1,185.1M, OCF 2,000.2M, capex (property and equipment) 74.6M, FCF 1,925.6M. At the 2026-11-09 close of 91.71 and 291.78M shares (Class A 263.23M plus Class B 28.55M at 2026-08-14) the market cap is about 26.8B: FCF yield 7.2%, and about 4.4% after subtracting FY26 stock-based compensation of 760.8M as a proxy. Cash and marketable securities were 7,249.7M at 2026-07-31 and no borrowings line appeared on the balance sheet, so enterprise value excluding cash is about 19.5B (10.1x TTM FCF, 16.5x TTM operating income). The 3.79B of strategic investments (3.66B measured at fair value, mostly Anthropic preferred stock marked up 1.61B in Q2 FY27) is an additional illiquid asset, not counted in the cash figure; excluding it too EV is about 15.7B. Company guides FY27 revenue 5.085-5.095B, non-GAAP operating income 2.065-2.075B and FCF 1.78-1.82B. Buybacks are heavy (3.7M shares in Q2; shares outstanding 292.3M vs 300.1M a year earlier). The market appears to price Zoom as an ex-growth business facing AI-assistant competition; evidence that differs is steady Enterprise acceleration, high margins and a net cash balance sheet, while the unresolved question is whether 5% growth persists.
counterthesis: Headline GAAP net income (Q2 1,542.4M, 6M 1,968.1M) is mostly unrealized gains on strategic investments (6M gains 1,766.5M) and says nothing about operating performance; TTM net income 3.26B should be ignored. Real operating income was flat to down in Q2 (314.3M vs 321.7M) and FCF fell 7% to 472.4M. Total growth is about 5% with a flat Online business, Enterprise expansion is still below 100%, and SBC (about 15% of revenue) offsets much of the buyback benefit. The Anthropic stake is concentrated, illiquid, valued on a private financing round and could be marked down; the company is also adding to it (300.9M invested in six months), pairing a software business with venture-style risk. Cash is invested largely in agency securities showing 41.8M of unrealized losses. A 2020 DOJ grand jury subpoena matter is still described in the 10-Q. Competitors (Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Cisco) bundle similar features.
invalidation: Enterprise growth falling back below about 5%, Online decline accelerating, non-GAAP operating margin dropping below about 37%, FCF decline beyond guidance, a large markdown or loss on the Anthropic holding, or buybacks paused while SBC dilution continues. The next quarterly report (fiscal Q3, date not verified; last year's pattern suggests around late November) can test this.
